# Test llms.txt static generation.

md2html -llms -html out -html-ext html -title Docs src

exists out/llms.txt
exists out/llms-full.txt
exists out/README.html
exists out/README.md
exists out/guide.html
exists out/guide.md
exists out/z-extra.html
exists out/z-extra.md

cmp out/llms.txt want-llms.txt
grep '^--- README.html$' out/llms-full.txt
grep '^--- guide.html$' out/llms-full.txt
grep '^--- z-extra.html$' out/llms-full.txt
grep '<link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown" href="./README.md">' out/README.html

# The dev server answers the same two URLs, built from the tree as it is
# now rather than from a previous static build.
md2html -http :8098 -nav src &
wait-port :8098

curl -s http://localhost:8098/llms.txt
stdout '^# Home$'
stdout '^> Frontmatter description wins\.$'
stdout '^## Start here$'
stdout '^- \[Home\]\(README\): Frontmatter description wins\.$'
stdout '^## Reference$'
stdout '^- \[Extra\]\(z-extra\): Extra summary outside navigation\.$'

curl -s http://localhost:8098/llms-full.txt
stdout '^--- README$'
stdout 'This paragraph should not be used'
stdout '^--- z-extra$'

-- want-llms.txt --
# Docs

> Frontmatter description wins.

## Pages

- [Home](README.html): Frontmatter description wins.
- [Guide](guide.html): Guide summary comes from the first paragraph.
- [Extra](z-extra.html): Extra summary outside navigation.
-- src/SUMMARY.md --
# Summary

## Start here

* [Home](README.md)
* [Guide](guide.md)

## Reference

* [z-extra](z-extra.md)

-- src/README.md --
---
description: Frontmatter description wins.
---
# Home

This paragraph should not be used.

-- src/guide.md --
# Guide

Guide summary comes from the first paragraph.

-- src/z-extra.md --
# Extra

Extra summary outside navigation.
